GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, taken straight across & Settled Down last 7 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 6.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # back/ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On leaving the gates became unbalanced after being bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Hooked Out 3 Wide at 650m and Moved Up to 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Held Ground in Straight # battled on fairly

Slow out 1 length and Settled Down last 12 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 14 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Four Wide rounding turn and fanned widest Straightening Up , Made Some Ground out very Wide in straight. [Stewards: Jockey reported that, despite his best efforts, it failed to improve into the race from the 500m.] # slow out/got back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide rounding the home turn and in the home straight. Rdr reported from the 500m point despite best efforts, mount failed to improve into the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down 8th 5 Lengths asked to go at the 800m Four Wide ran into Lead x 500m, held a margin until the 150m 1st saved every inch 1st had last crack - Sound Effort # early 4 Wide move
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out near the 800m when the pace of the race slackened and was permitted to stride. Laid out under pressure round home turn and in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out no rush came across settled down second last 10 Lengths (1500m), last 800 length or two Further back, did improve To The Turn , Straightened Up running on kept finding the line Without threat # from well back

Jumped well landing with the leaders, soon eased to park third 2-3 Lengths (1400m), one x one midrace, peeled 3 Wide approaching Turn coming up to challenge Straight , swept to the lead 250, kept on going # outstayed them

Jumped only fairly, failed to muster early speed & Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, Moved Up to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted out Straightening Up and Made Some Ground early in Straight before shifting in behind runners and across to gain runs to the line. [Stewards: COT - From the inside barrier, to settle further forward if circumstances permitted. Failed to muster early speed and settled worse than midfield.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT - settle further forward. Unable to muster early speed despite the urgings of its rider and settled worse than midfield. Inconvenienced over the concluding stages and obliged to alter course.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slowly away and Settled Down a clear last 14 Lengths from the lead, trailed 13 Lengths turning and one-paced in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it would appreciate a significant step-up in distance on a bigger track as it was not suited by the tight turning track, as well as being placed back to maiden class. Post-race vet exam revealed no significant abnormalities. Warning placed on it for poor performance.] # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped at the start. When asked about performance, Rdr stated mount would appreciate a significant step up in distance on a bigger track as it was not suited to the tight turning track, as well as being placed back to maiden class. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Warning for poor performance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length then dropped out last 14 Lengths from the lead, railked to 10 Lengths last turning, improved a length in Straight # slow out/got back

Restrained from the gate settled back last tightened for room 7 Lengths (1600m), still well back in the run To The Turn , Straightened Up Under Whip last, passed a few home however never likely # closest late
